name: Spring AI Tool-Calling Review Pack
purpose: Review Spring AI integrations for prompt construction quality, tool-calling safety, output handling reliability, observability, and security/privacy. Covers ChatClient, ToolCallback, @Tool, prompt templates, VectorStore, and structured output converter patterns.
when_to_use: When reviewing or assessing Spring AI workflow code
When evaluating tool-calling definitions for safety
When assessing AI integration reliability and observability
notes: Add domain.mysql or domain.redis when repository/query or cache semantics are part of the AI workflow
Escalate to workflow.full_default if review becomes change-oriented
This pack provides the routing entry that domain.spring-ai needs to be discoverable through pack-first routing
